title: Police Department
key_finding: The City describes the Lauderhill Police Department as a progressive, community-oriented, professionally accredited law-enforcement agency.

title: Meet the Chief
key_finding: The City identifies Chief Constance Stanley as Lauderhill's chief of police and describes her long Lauderhill Police Department career.

title: Budget Documents
key_finding: The City maintains current operating-budget publications including Fiscal Year 2026 and Fiscal Year 2025.

title: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget
key_finding: The FY2026 budget contains a Police Department section stating that the department is responsible for community safety, describes three police divisions, and reports 68,496 calls for service in FY2025.

title: BSO District Offices
key_finding: BSO says some Broward cities maintain their own police departments and that BSO may provide communications and dispatch to some of them, which is inconsistent with treating Lauderhill as a sheriff-primary contract city.

title: Contracts and Other Documents
key_finding: BSO's municipal-contracts page does not list Lauderhill, which is direct sheriff-side evidence against a BSO contract-city policing model for Lauderhill.

title: FDLE Agency Search / ORI Registry
key_finding: FDLE's official criminal justice agency registry lists Lauderhill Police Department with ORI FL0061800.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2020A
key_finding: FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal offense report lists Lauderhill Police Department with population 72,507 and total index crime 2,541.

title: County and Municipal Offense Report 2021A
key_finding: FDLE's 2021 county-and-municipal offense report still lists a Lauderhill Police Department row with population 74,538, while Broward County's page notes that the 2021 estimate was unavailable because of a limited-size data sample and the offense fields are shown as '--'.

title: UCR Incident-Based Reports landing page
key_finding: FDLE states that Florida incident-based reporting data are available for the 2021-2024 and 2025 reporting cycles via downloadable Excel workbooks.

title: FIBRS Offense Detail 2021-2025 Q2 workbook
key_finding: Inspection of the official FIBRS offense workbook found no Lauderhill row in the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, or 2025 Q2 sheets even though several Broward municipal peers appear.

title: agency_to_jurisdiction_crosswalk.parquet
key_finding: The live crosswalk routes FL0061800 exclusively to 12:municipal:place:1239550.

title: agency_master.parquet
key_finding: FL0061800 is classified as a local police department and is flagged with SRS and NIBRS presence through 2024.

title: agency_year_observations.parquet
key_finding: Repo observations show FL0061800 with annual Part I totals of 2,864 in 2018, 2,702 in 2019, and 2,541 in 2020, followed by zero-valued SRS annual rows in 2021 through 2024 and no NIBRS rows.

title: jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet
key_finding: All 2024 Lauderhill offense controls are fully filled because preferred reported support is zero and the row is treated as structurally missing or unreliable.

title: municipal_target_review_queue.parquet
key_finding: Lauderhill is queued in high_impact_full_fill_place with total_fill_count 2702.0, total_reported_count 0.0, and priority_rank 2.
